svg.title: Pericentric inversion loop
svg.desc: Four physical chromatids pair in an inversion loop. The orange and ochre inverted homolog has c before b; the blue and green normal homolog has b before c. A single exchange involves the ochre and green nonsisters. Centromeres are inside the inverted interval. White gaps indicate overpasses.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic, created 2026-11-10. Source facts: genetics/LECT13/djot/assets/lect13b-chromo_alter_3-inversion/image_010.png; original ODP slides 6, 10, 12, 14, 16. Geometry newly composed, not traced. Unmeasured. Source labels and stage/copy counts preserved.
